verdict.rationale: A natural-language interface is a fair question for an online payment service, so the axis applies, but the evidence documents no natural-language command capability. The voice response system is a prompt-driven phone menu, which is an adjacent control and not natural-language operation. Probes also found no llms.txt or OpenAPI surface that an AI layer could use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
